p: Schultz will continue as a source of explosive plays.
Ryans cited him as a producer of explosive plays, a good sign for his TE usage.
Schultz will keep being a main target for Stroud and stay heavily involved in the passing game.
Ryans praised his zone-beating and his connection with Stroud, and said more tight end sets are coming, so Schultz's target floor looks safe.
Dalton has always been that playmaker for us.
